\[
\begin{gathered}
K_{\text{N}} = \begin{bmatrix} 5 & 5 & 5 \\ -3 & 0 & -3 \\ -3 & -3 & -3 \end{bmatrix},
\qquad
G = \max_{k = 0, \dots, 7} \bigl( K_k \star I \bigr)
\end{gathered}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(K_k\): The mask turned by k steps of 45 degrees
- \(G\): The largest response

The north mask weights the top row with 5 and the rest of the ring with -3. Moving its outer ring by one cell turns it by 45 degrees. The eight masks cover all directions, and the largest response is the edge strength. The mask that gives it is the direction.
